44157b6c-9419-4f46-935e-4f9a91a1489a.intro: In Tennessee, you should contact the state-specific hotline or the national hotline. If anyone is in immediate danger, always call 911 first.

sections.title: Tennessee Human Trafficking Hotline
sections.description: This is the primary state resource, operated in partnership with the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation (TBI).

sections.title: National Human Trafficking Hotline
sections.description: This provides nationwide support and can connect victims with local services.
